description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Izzet Chronarch
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Izzet Chronarch
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
